findings.current: could recover from almost any wound
findings.defect: The source describes the Black Ghosts as having recovery so powerful it is nearly immortal. It does not specify that they can recover from almost any wound; that wording adds a claim about the range of injuries they can recover from.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 불사에 가까운 회복력, meaning recovery close to immortality, without specifying particular wounds.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful; one phrase adds a more specific recovery claim than the Korean establishes.
